help.title: ❓ Help
help.whatIsBody: Verdex is a local document intelligence orchestration platform. It extracts structured knowledge from documents, runs multi-model analysis, and synthesizes results — all on your machine, API requests sent directly from your device.
help.tasksBody: Pick a task type in the config bar — this determines what Verdex does:
help.taskExtract: 📄 Document Extract: Load documents → extract structured JSON (e.g. mental models, causal chains). Best for converting raw text into structured data.
help.taskAnalysis: 📊 Document Analysis: Extract first → multiple models analyze the extracted knowledge → Judge synthesizes. Best for deep multi-perspective analysis (requires ≥2 models).
help.taskQa: 💬 Quick Q&A: Ask a question → multiple models answer in parallel → Judge synthesizes. Best for getting diverse opinions on any question.
help.settingsTask: Task: Choose what to do (document extract / analysis / quick Q&A). The config bar adapts — only relevant options show.
help.settingsSchema: Extract Structure: Pick a JSON schema for document tasks (e.g. Mental Model Library). Controls what structure the AI extracts.
help.settingsStyle: Analysis Style: How the Judge synthesizes multiple model answers (Default four-field / Strict logic / Multi-perspective).
help.settingsPanel: Experts: Which models participate in parallel analysis. More models = more diverse perspectives.
help.settingsJudge: Judge: Which model synthesizes the final result. Pick a strong reasoner for best quality.
help.settingsClean: Clean: ASR cleaning — fixes speech-to-text errors (entity names, numbers, typos). Enable only for noisy ASR data.
help.settingsMemory: Memory: When on, each model remembers prior turns in the conversation.
help.flowExtract: Document Extract: Documents → [Clean] → Extract by Schema → Structured JSON. Large corpora auto-trigger Map-Reduce (parallel extraction + merge).
help.flowAnalysis: Document Analysis: Stage 1 Extract → Stage 2 Experts analyze extracted knowledge → Stage 3 Judge synthesizes into four-field verdict.
help.flowQa: Quick Q&A: Question → Experts answer in parallel → Judge synthesizes consensus/divergence/blindspots/verdict.
help.docsBody: Click 📎 to attach .txt/.md files. Their text is injected into the prompt (document tasks) or processed per-file (Map-Reduce). Attachments persist per session.
help.providersBody: Open Settings (⚙️) → Providers to add models. Fill Base URL + API Key + model name. Click "🔌 Test connection" to verify. Any OpenAI-compatible API works (DeepSeek, Qwen, Groq, etc.).
help.schemasBody: Settings → 📋 Schemas to manage extraction templates. Define what JSON structure to extract (fields, required keys). Built-in: Mental Model Library, Four-field verdict.
help.copyMdBody: Click "📋 Copy as MD" next to any structured result to copy it as formatted Markdown to clipboard.
help.shortcutsBody: Ctrl/⌘+Enter: send. Enter: newline. While running: click Stop to abort.
help.useCasesBest: Best for: unstructured text → structured knowledge (podcast transcripts → mental models); multi-document comparison/synthesis (7 reports → unified framework); multi-perspective deep analysis (investment evaluation, proposal review); noisy ASR data cleaning.
help.useCasesGood: Also good for: quick multi-opinion Q&A; long document condensation; cross-document entity/causal extraction.
help.useCasesNot: Not suited for: real-time data / web search (no internet); images/video/audio (text only); code execution; precise numerical calculation.
help.configBody: All data (providers, API keys, sessions, templates) is stored locally in config.json. Nothing is uploaded. API requests go directly from your device to the provider.
help.securityBody: API keys are stored in plaintext in config.json. Do not commit this file to public repos.
